captions.formal: An orange kitten stands and walks toward a stationary camera on a dirt path, lifting its right front paw while moving through a wooded area of thin trunks and green foliage.
captions.sarcastic: A truly grueling trek: a few feet of dirt path and a single lifted paw, yet the kitten manages to make it look like a daring expedition.
captions.humorous_tech: Orange kitten initiates a deployment from seating to walking, cautiously testing the dirt path for latency with a single lifted paw.
captions.humorous_non_tech: This orange kitten marches through the woods with the intense focus of a tiny forest ranger about to issue a very stern warning.
